title: Diffusion Editing with Soft Mask: Pixel Level Redo of Image and Video with Adjustable Strength
title_zh: 基于软掩码的扩散编辑：以可调强度实现图像与视频的像素级重制

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models with prompt and reference image-guided editing have seen rapid progress, yet they remain too coarse for pixel-level control. One promising direction is to incorporate a soft mask that specifies spatially varying edit strengths—but training such fine-grained control demands expensive pixel-wise annotations, while existing zero-shot methods often yield unsatisfactory results. We introduce SoftPaint , a new zero-shot sampling method that leverages soft masks to enable a continuous spectrum of edits, from fully preserving the original content to completely re-synthesizing the masked region. Going beyond zero-shot inpainting methods, we design a Langevin-iteration-based sampler that respects per-pixel soft mask strengths, which applies universally to image and video diffusion models, enabling tasks such as video editing. The method is gradient-free, memory-efficient, and achieves smooth, pixel-level edits across multiple image and video backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 在提示词和参考图像引导下进行编辑的扩散模型取得了快速进展，但它们在像素级控制方面仍然过于粗糙。 一个有前景的方向是引入软掩码，以指定空间上变化的编辑强度——然而，训练这种精细控制需要昂贵的逐像素标注，而现有的零样本方法通常会产生令人不满意的结果。 我们提出了 SoftPaint，一种新的零样本采样方法，它利用软掩码来实现连续变化的编辑效果，从完全保留原始内容到对掩码区域进行完全重新合成。 除了零样本图像修复方法之外，我们还设计了一种基于朗之万迭代的采样器，该采样器能够尊重每个像素的软掩码强度，并普遍适用于图像和视频扩散模型，从而支持视频编辑等任务。 该方法无需梯度计算、内存效率高，并且能在多种图像和视频基础模型上实现平滑的像素级编辑。

paragraphs.en: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] have emerged as powerful generative frameworks that produce high-quality outputs through iterative denoising. Subsequent advances in ODE-based deterministic samplers [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , as well as equivalent rectified flow models [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , have dramatically improved the efficiency of DDPMs, reducing the sampling steps from hundreds to dozens. Recent unified generation-and-editing models, such as FLUX.1 Kontext [ 13 ] and Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-Edit [ 14 ] , further demonstrate how these backbones now support high-quality instruction-based image editing in addition to image synthesis. Together, these innovations have broadened the scope and quality of generative visual art.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPMs）[ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] 已成为强大的生成框架，通过迭代去噪生成高质量输出。 随后基于常微分方程的确定性采样器 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] 以及等效的整流流模型 [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] 的进步，显著提升了 DDPMs 的效率，将采样步数从数百减少到数十。 近期的统一生成与编辑模型，如 FLUX.1 Kontext [ 13 ] 和 Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-Edit [ 14 ] ，进一步展示了这些基础模型如今除了图像合成外，还支持高质量、基于指令的图像编辑。 这些创新共同拓展了生成视觉艺术的范畴并提升了其质量。

paragraphs.en: Consider a digital artist or a casual user who wishes to edit an image or video. They often have a reference 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} and want to modify specific parts while preserving others. While text prompts can describe the desired change, they are often too coarse to precisely specify the exact region to be modified. Binary masks, as used in standard inpainting, improve spatial control, but they still enforce a hard decision between “preserve exactly” and “change completely.” In practice, however, user intent is rarely binary; they often desire a continuous control of redo strength —for example, slightly broadening an original smile, or turning the original sky into a dramatic sunset while preserving its rough layout. A natural way to express such intent is through a soft mask, whose values specify how strongly each spatial location should adhere to the reference image. Figure 1 shows how a single generation with such a continuous-opacity mask yields a spatially graded edit. Furthermore, with the rapid release of diverse open-source models (e.g., Stable Diffusion, FLUX, Qwen-Image) from various organizations, users need a universal editing tool that works out-of-the-box for any model, without waiting for model-specific fine-tuning or training specialized adapters.

paragraphs.en: Current approaches to conditional sampling often face significant trade-offs. Training-based methods [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] are effective for binary inpainting, but extending them to soft redo is much more difficult: preparing supervision for continuous per-pixel redo strengths is expensive, typically requires enormous teams of expert human labelers. On the other hand, training-free methods often either rely on heavy gradient computations (backpropagating through the U-Net), leading to prohibitive GPU memory usage for large production models, or suffer from inferior performance.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的条件采样方法通常面临显著的权衡问题。 基于训练的方法 [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] 在二值修复方面效果显著，但要将其扩展到软性重做则困难得多：为每个像素的连续重做强度准备监督信号成本高昂，通常需要庞大的专家人工标注团队。 另一方面，无需训练的方法要么依赖复杂的梯度计算（通过 U-Net 反向传播），导致大型生产模型需要极高的 GPU 显存，要么性能较差。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose SoftPaint , a pixel-level redo sampler that is model-agnostic and training-free , based on Langevin Dynamics Monte Carlo. SoftPaint supports flow models, as well as ODE- and SDE-based diffusion models. It introduces two core innovations: (1) the Unified Redo (UR) Score , a unified guided score for the entire image that combines the diffusion prior score with an analytic Gaussian tether to the reference; and (2) Diffusion-Damped Langevin (DDL) , a diffusion-damped Langevin solver that improves stability under large step sizes while keeping the sampling algorithm simple. Experiments confirm that SoftPaint produces high-quality image and video inpainting, while enabling fine-grained redo control for general editing. By avoiding gradient computations, SoftPaint is memory-efficient and deployment-friendly, empowering users to perform soft redo on consumer hardware across diverse diffusion architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 SoftPaint——一种基于朗之万动力学蒙特卡洛方法的像素级重采样器，它不依赖特定模型且无需训练。 SoftPaint 支持流模型，以及基于常微分方程（ODE）和随机微分方程（SDE）的扩散模型。 它引入了两项核心创新：（1）统一重采样得分（UR Score），一种适用于整张图像的统一引导得分，将扩散先验得分与参考图像的解析高斯约束相结合；以及（2）扩散阻尼朗之万方法（Diffusion-Damped Langevin, DDL），一种通过引入扩散阻尼来提高大步长下稳定性的朗之万求解器，同时保持采样算法的简洁性。 实验证明，SoftPaint 能够生成高质量的图像和视频修复效果，同时支持精细的重采样控制，适用于通用编辑任务。 由于无需进行梯度计算，SoftPaint 在内存使用上十分高效且易于部署，使用户能够在消费级硬件上，针对多种扩散架构实现柔性的重采样操作。

paragraphs.en: Inpainting in diffusion models traditionally relies on binary masks to distinguish between known and unknown regions. However, practical editing scenarios often require finer control over the degree of preservation for each pixel. This motivates the transition from binary inpainting to soft inpainting , where a continuous soft mask controls the redo strength. In this section, we formalize both settings and highlight the non-trivial challenges that arise when extending binary masks to continuous ones.
paragraphs.zh: 在扩散模型中，内容填充传统上依赖二进制掩码来区分已知区域和未知区域。 然而，实际编辑场景通常需要更精细地控制每个像素的保留程度。 这促使我们从二进制内容填充转向软内容填充，其中连续的软掩码用于控制重绘强度。 在本节中，我们将对这两种设定进行形式化描述，并重点说明将二进制掩码扩展为连续掩码时所出现的非平凡挑战。

paragraphs.en: Instead of naive blending, transitioning to soft inpainting requires a more principled formulation of the target distribution and a corresponding sampling algorithm compatible with diffusion dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 与简单的混合方法不同，转向软修复需要对目标分布进行更基于原理的构建，并采用与之对应的、能够与扩散动力学兼容的采样算法。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we define a well-behaved target distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 ) q(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}) parameterized by the continuous soft mask 𝐫 ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] H × W \mathbf{r}\in[0,1]^{H\times W} , which must satisfy the following properties:
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们定义了一个行为良好的目标分布 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 ) q(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r})，其参数由连续软掩码 𝐫 ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] H × W \mathbf{r}\in[0,1]^{H\times W} 决定，且必须满足以下性质：

paragraphs.en: Well-defined distribution : q ⁡ ( 𝐱 | 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 ) q(\mathbf{x}|\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}) must be a valid probability density function.
paragraphs.zh: 明确定义的分布：q⁡(𝐱|𝐱₀ᶠ,𝐫) q(\mathbf{x}|\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}) 必须是一个有效的概率密度函数。

paragraphs.en: Boundary conditions : At extreme values, q q must recover standard behaviors: 𝐫 = 0 \mathbf{r}=0 yields perfect reconstruction q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 = 0 ) = δ ⁡ ( 𝐱 − 𝐱 0 ref ) q(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}=0)=\delta(\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0}) , while 𝐫 = 1 \mathbf{r}=1 reduces to free generation q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 = 1 ) = p ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) q(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}=1)=p(\mathbf{x}) .
paragraphs.zh: 边界条件：在极端值情况下，q q 必须恢复标准行为：当 𝐫 = 0 \mathbf{r}=0 时，可得到完美重建 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 = 0 ) = δ ⁡ ( 𝐱 − 𝐱 0 ref ) q(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}=0)=\delta(\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0})；而当 𝐫 = 1 \mathbf{r}=1 时，则简化为自由生成 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐱 0 ref , 𝐫 = 1 ) = p ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) q(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{x}^{\text{ref}}_{0},\mathbf{r}=1)=p(\mathbf{x})。

paragraphs.en: Smooth interpolation : For intermediate 𝐫 \mathbf{r} , q q must continuously and smoothly blend between reconstruction and generation, with pixel-wise control.
paragraphs.zh: 平滑插值：对于中间值 𝐫 \mathbf{r}，q q 必须能够在重建与生成之间连续、平滑地过渡，并支持像素级控制。

paragraphs.en: Samplability : q q should be tractable to sample using a pre-trained unconditional diffusion model without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 可采样性：q 应能够通过预训练的无条件扩散模型进行采样，而无需重新训练。

paragraphs.en: The transition from binary to soft inpainting is highly non-trivial because simple pixel-space interpolation does not yield a valid probability distribution. SoftPaint addresses this by introducing the Unified Redo (UR) Score , derived from a target distribution that satisfies above four properties and enables efficient sampling via a novel Langevin-based algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 从二值化到软修复的转换绝非易事，因为简单的像素空间插值无法生成有效的概率分布。 SoftPaint 通过引入统一重做（UR）分数来解决这一问题，该分数源自一个满足上述四个特性的目标分布，并借助一种新颖的基于朗之万算法的方法实现了高效采样。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 showed that a static blending weight 𝐫 \mathbf{r} is too limited for continuous soft inpainting. We want the reference strength to change smoothly over time: early in sampling, the model should stay close to the reference to preserve coherence, while later it should gain more freedom to redo. We also allow the blending weight to extrapolate (exceed 1 1 ), so it can go beyond simple interpolation and actively strengthen the influence of the reference image. This extrapolation helps preserve structure and improve coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节表明，静态混合权重 𝐫 \mathbf{r} 对于连续的软修复来说过于有限。 我们希望参考强度随时间平滑变化：在采样初期，模型应保持在参考图像附近以维持连贯性；而在后期，则应获得更多自由度以便重新处理。 我们还允许混合权重进行外推（超过 1 1 ），这样它就能超越简单的插值，主动增强参考图像的影响。 这种外推有助于保留结构并提升连贯性。

paragraphs.en: This experiment asks two questions: (i) Does SoftPaint provide finer controllability as well as smooth edit strength? (ii) At matched controllability, does SoftPaint produce higher-quality edits? The FlowEdit benchmark [ 22 ] is well-suited here because its diverse object-centric masks and paired source/target prompts let us decouple “how much the edit was realized” (CLIP-Text) from “how clean the result looks” (LPIPS, PSNR, CLIP-IQA, FID).
paragraphs.zh: 本实验提出两个问题：(i) SoftPaint 是否提供了更精细的可控性，以及更平滑的编辑强度？ (ii) 在可控性相当的情况下，SoftPaint 能否生成质量更高的编辑结果？ FlowEdit 基准测试 [ 22 ] 非常适合此处的分析，因为其多样化的以物体为中心的掩码以及成对的源/目标提示，使我们能够将“编辑实现的程度”（CLIP-Text）与“结果看起来的清晰度”（LPIPS、PSNR、CLIP-IQA、FID）分离开来。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Models and Image/Video Editing. Diffusion models [ 4 ] have become a dominant paradigm for high-quality image and video generation. Early work accelerated the stochastic DDPM sampling process via deterministic ODE flows, notably DDIM [ 27 ] and advanced ODE solvers, enabling fewer-step generation. Rectified flow [ 10 , 11 ] further reparameterized the ODE-based diffusion with improved numerical properties, later scaling to large text-to-image and text-to-video models such as Stable Diffusion 3 [ 28 ] and FLUX [ 29 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型与图像/视频编辑。 扩散模型 [ 4 ] 已成为生成高质量图像和视频的主流范式。 早期研究通过确定性 ODE 流加速了随机 DDPM 采样过程，尤其是 DDIM [ 27 ] 和先进的 ODE 求解器，从而实现了更少步数的生成。 修正流 [ 10 , 11 ] 进一步对基于 ODE 的扩散模型进行了重参数化，并改善了其数值特性，随后被扩展应用于大型文本到图像和文本到视频模型，例如 Stable Diffusion 3 [ 28 ] 和 FLUX [ 29 ]。

paragraphs.en: Beyond generation, diffusion models have been widely adopted for image and video editing , where an input image or video together with a text prompt specifies the desired edit. A large body of work has tackled this problem from different angles: instruction-based editing via fine-tuning on paired data [ 30 ] , spatial conditioning through plug-in modules [ 15 ] , image-prompt adaptation with decoupled cross-attention [ 31 ] , and multi-task frameworks unifying diverse editing operations [ 32 ] . More recently, large-scale proprietary models such as FLUX.2 Kontext [ 29 ] and Qwen-Image [ 14 ] have integrated reference-image conditioning directly into their training pipelines, supporting multi-reference and text-image-to-image editing with strong semantic preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 除了生成任务，扩散模型还被广泛用于图像和视频编辑，其中输入图像或视频与文本提示共同指定了期望的编辑效果。 大量研究从不同角度解决了这一问题：通过配对数据微调实现指令式编辑 [30]、借助插件模块进行空间条件约束 [15]、利用解耦交叉注意力实现图像提示适配 [31]，以及将多种编辑操作统一的多任务框架 [32]。 近期，FLUX.2 Kontext [29] 和 Qwen-Image [14] 等大型专有模型已将参考图像条件约束直接整合到训练流程中，从而支持多参考图像编辑及文本到图像的图像编辑，同时能强效保留语义信息。

sents.en: Beyond generation, diffusion models have been widely adopted for image and video editing , where an input image or video together with a text prompt specifies the desired edit.
sents.zh: 除了生成任务，扩散模型还被广泛用于图像和视频编辑，其中输入图像或视频与文本提示共同指定了期望的编辑效果。

sents.en: A large body of work has tackled this problem from different angles: instruction-based editing via fine-tuning on paired data [ 30 ] , spatial conditioning through plug-in modules [ 15 ] , image-prompt adaptation with decoupled cross-attention [ 31 ] , and multi-task frameworks unifying diverse editing operations [ 32 ] .
sents.zh: 大量研究从不同角度解决了这一问题：通过配对数据微调实现指令式编辑 [30]、借助插件模块进行空间条件约束 [15]、利用解耦交叉注意力实现图像提示适配 [31]，以及将多种编辑操作统一的多任务框架 [32]。

sents.en: More recently, large-scale proprietary models such as FLUX.2 Kontext [ 29 ] and Qwen-Image [ 14 ] have integrated reference-image conditioning directly into their training pipelines, supporting multi-reference and text-image-to-image editing with strong semantic preservation.
sents.zh: 近期，FLUX.2 Kontext [29] 和 Qwen-Image [14] 等大型专有模型已将参考图像条件约束直接整合到训练流程中，从而支持多参考图像编辑及文本到图像的图像编辑，同时能强效保留语义信息。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advances, existing image and video editing models operate at the semantic level and provide limited fine-grained spatial control—users cannot specify how strongly each individual pixel should be edited. This gap motivates our approach, which introduces a soft mask mechanism for continuous, pixel-level edit-strength control in a training-free manner.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，现有的图像和视频编辑模型仍在语义层面上运行，且仅提供有限的精细空间控制——用户无法指定每个像素应被编辑的强度。 这一差距促使我们提出了当前方法，该方法引入了一种软掩码机制，无需训练即可实现连续、像素级的编辑强度控制。

paragraphs.en: Training-Free Conditional Editing with Diffusion Models. A line of training-free methods tackles conditional editing by enforcing spatial constraints during the reverse diffusion process. Langevin-based approaches [ 33 ] such as RePaint [ 19 ] and LanPaint [ 34 ] perform iterative denoise–renoise under binary inpainting masks [ 35 ] , while Sequential Monte Carlo methods [ 36 , 37 ] and linear-inverse-based techniques [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] address similar hard-constraint settings. However, these methods share two key limitations: (i) they are designed for binary masks and do not support continuous-opacity soft masks, and (ii) many rely on gradient-based optimization or line search, incurring 2–4 × \times higher GPU memory than standard inference.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散模型的免训练条件编辑。 一系列免训练方法通过在反向扩散过程中施加空间约束来解决条件编辑问题。 Langevin 基方法 [ 33 ]（如 RePaint [ 19 ] 和 LanPaint [ 34 ]）在二元图像修复掩码 [ 35 ] 下执行迭代去噪–重噪操作，而 Sequential Monte Carlo 方法 [ 36 , 37 ] 和线性逆基技术 [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] 则处理类似的硬约束设置。 然而，这些方法存在两个关键局限性：(i) 它们专为二元掩码设计，不支持连续不透明度的软掩码；(ii) 许多方法依赖基于梯度的优化或线性搜索，导致 GPU 内存占用比标准推理高 2–4 倍（\times）。

paragraphs.en: Differential Diffusion [ 26 ] is a notable exception that enables per-pixel edit-strength control, effectively supporting soft masks in a training-free manner. However, its underlying editing capability is limited: on binary masks it reduces to the naive replace method [ 19 ] , which in turn constrains its soft-mask performance. Our proposed method, SoftPaint, addresses both gaps: it natively supports continuous soft masks with a memory-efficient, gradient-free sampler that is compatible with modern ODE-based diffusion backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 差分扩散 [ 26 ] 是一个显著的例外，它支持逐像素编辑强度控制，从而无需训练即可有效实现软掩码。 然而，其底层的编辑能力有限：在二进制掩码上，它退化为简单的替换方法 [ 19 ] ，而这种方法又限制了其在软掩码上的表现。 我们提出的 SoftPaint 方法解决了这两个问题：它原生支持连续软掩码，并采用一种内存高效且无需梯度的采样器，该采样器与现代基于 ODE 的扩散模型主干架构兼容。

paragraphs.en: We introduced SoftPaint, a training-free and model-agnostic sampler for continuous soft-mask image and video editing. By combining the Unified Redo score with Diffusion-Damped Langevin, SoftPaint enables pixel-level redo control while remaining gradient-free and memory-efficient. Experiments show improved edit controllability and a better quality-preservation trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SoftPaint，这是一种无需训练且与模型无关的采样器，适用于连续软掩码图像和视频编辑。 通过将统一重做分数（Unified Redo score）与扩散阻尼朗之万方法（Diffusion-Damped Langevin）相结合，SoftPaint 实现了像素级的重做控制，同时保持无梯度且内存高效。 实验表明，该方法提升了编辑的可控性，并在质量保留方面实现了更优的权衡。

sents.zh: 我们提出了 SoftPaint，这是一种无需训练且与模型无关的采样器，适用于连续软掩码图像和视频编辑。

sents.en: Experiments show improved edit controllability and a better quality-preservation trade-off.
sents.zh: 实验表明，该方法提升了编辑的可控性，并在质量保留方面实现了更优的权衡。

paragraphs.en: A practical consideration for SoftPaint is its inference speed. As a training-free method that requires no additional optimization or fine-tuning, SoftPaint can be directly applied to any pretrained diffusion backbone with the same memory footprint as standard generation. The trade-off is that each inner Langevin iteration introduces one extra network evaluation, making the overall generation roughly 2 × 2\times – 5 × 5\times slower than the backbone’s standard sampling. This latency can be a practical limitation for interactive editing and large-scale deployment. However,we believe the zero-training cost and universal compatibility offer a reasonable trade-off; further speed improvements are left to future work.
paragraphs.zh: SoftPaint 的一个实际考量因素是其推理速度。 作为一种无需训练的方法，SoftPaint 不需要任何额外的优化或微调，可以直接应用于任何预训练的扩散模型主干网络，且内存占用与标准生成相同。 其权衡之处在于，每次内层的朗之万迭代都会引入一次额外的网络评估，导致整体生成速度比主干网络的标准采样慢大约 2 × 2\times – 5 × 5\times。 这种延迟可能对交互式编辑和大规模部署构成实际限制。 然而，我们认为零训练成本和通用兼容性提供了一个合理的权衡；进一步的速度提升留待未来的工作。
